laws.rule: The Galápagos Council official TCT FAQ says tourists need a Tarjeta de Control de Tránsito, presented on entry to and exit from the province, current identification or passport, and a personal return air ticket between the mainland and Galápagos. It describes a maximum tourist stay of 60 non-extendable days in the year and says tourist status does not permit income-earning activity. Confirm current documentary requirements with the Council before travel.
